messages:
anna_prodsec: :rotating_light: Security advisory — active eBPF privilege escalation (public proof-of-concept). We need immediate mitigation across all Redwood-managed nodes and guidance out to Private customers. Details and steps below; 72-hour deadline for infra upgrades and mitigations.

david_infra: any CVE number we can reference?

anna_prodsec: Not yet assigned publicly; this is a rapidly circulating PoC exploiting unprivileged eBPF on kernels < 6.1 in certain configurations. Vendor guidance recommends kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1 where feasible and patching to patched kernels ASAP.

mike_sre: Quick checklist for our fleets?

anna_prodsec: Short version: (1) Verify kernel sysctl: `sysctl kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled` should be 1. (2) If not, set immediately via `sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1` and make persistent (`/etc/sysctl.d/99-unprivileged-bpf.conf`). (3) Roll OS/kernel uptream images that include the vendor patch within 72 hours. (4) For containers, enforce seccomp and drop CAP_BPF/CAP_PERFMON where applicable.

lina_engineering: For our Hosted API GPUs we run custom kernels — what's the plan for those nodes?

david_infra: We're kicking a rolling upgrade job to images with the patched kernel and the sysctl set by default. For GPU hosts where live kernel upgrade is risky, we will enforce the sysctl via sysctl.d and cordon/drain for maintenance windows. ETA for full rollout: 48 hours for non-GPU nodes, 72 hours for GPU fleets.

mike_sre: Add a DaemonSet to enforce sysctl on kube nodes as temporary measure?

anna_prodsec: Yes — use this approved daemonset snippet for clusters we control. NOTE: For Dedicated/Private customers we will NOT apply automatically; we will provide manifests and patch instructions. DaemonSet (one-liner):

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: enforce-unpriv-bpf
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: enforce-unpriv-bpf
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: enforce-unpriv-bpf
    spec:
      hostPID: true
      containers:
      - name: enforcer
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1 || true; sleep 3600"]
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
      tolerations:
      - operator: "Exists"
```

carol_cto: Will this change affect any of the inference workloads (performance or functionality)?

lina_engineering: Most model serving paths don't rely on unprivileged eBPF. Potential impact only for teams using custom eBPF-based perf hooks or observability sidecars. If you have eBPF-based tracing, open a ticket ASAP.

mike_sre: Detection queries to run across nodes (quick):
- check sysctl: `ssh node 'sysctl -n kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled'`
- detect active eBPF programs: `bpftool prog show` (requires root)
- look for `CAP_BPF`/`CAP_PERFMON` in container capabilities via `crictl ps -q | xargs -n1 crictl inspect | jq '.info.runtimeSpec.linux.capabilities'`

anna_prodsec: For private deployments: we'll publish a customer-ready KB and a yaml manifest for the daemonset + sysctl file. Private customers must acknowledge and schedule patching within 7 days; we will provide support windows.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INC-2026: "Unprivileged eBPF advisory — fleet mitigation" (assignees: @david_infra, @mike_sre).

david_infra: Quick RFC: for short-term we enable sysctl=1 cluster-wide on hosted and Dedicated; for Private we provide guidance only. Confirming no automatic changes to customer-managed nodes.

anna_prodsec: Correct. Also: rotate any agent tokens used by observability agents that run with elevated privileges as a precaution — do a token rotation sweep and report to sec-sweeps channel after rotation.

lina_engineering: Any mitigations for local dev setups or CI runners?

mike_sre: Dev boxes: recommend `sudo sysctl -w kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=1`. CI runners: if self-hosted, set sysctl in runner startup; if using hosted CI, contact infra for status.

anna_prodsec: Action items summary (everyone):
- Infra: roll sysctl + kernel image updates across fleets (48–72h) — @david_infra
- SRE: deploy detection daemonset and run discovery sweep — @mike_sre
- Eng teams: audit code for eBPF usage, drop CAP_BPF where unnecessary — owners per service
- Security: publish KB + Private customer guidance and coordinate support windows — @anna_prodsec

anna_prodsec: I'll send an email to execs and post a follow-up with the KB link here shortly. If you hit blockers, DM me. :lock:
